name: section-heading
label: Section heading with rule
description: A section heading with the short green-to-gold rule above it, and an optional larger lead line under it.
template:
{{#if rule}}{{/if}}

{{heading}}

{{#if lead}}

{{lead}}

{{/if}}

ai.purpose: Opens a section with the site's signature short rule and a heading.
ai.whenToUse: At the top of most content sections after the page's first section.
ai.avoid: The first section of a page (that uses the page title).
